product.name: Urbano Fashion Men's Slim Fit Denim Jeans
product.description: Urbano Fashion men's slim-fit solid stretch jeans featuring a mid-rise design, full-length cut and stretchable cotton-Lycra fabric. Designed for casual, office and party wear with a lightweight, comfortable fit.

review_summary.summary: Customers generally find these jeans comfortable and reasonably priced. The strongest positives are stretch, lightweight construction, fit for some buyers and value for money. However, reviews repeatedly raise concerns about color fading, sizing accuracy, material quality and durability.
positive: Good value at the budget price
Suitable for casual and everyday wear
negative: Blue dye can leave a bluish tint on other clothes
Sizing does not always match advertised measurements
Some buyers say it does not look as slim as advertised
Some color shades differ from product images
One verified review reports persistent fabric smell
review_summary.main_concern: Quality consistency. The jeans can be a good budget purchase for comfort and casual wear, but customer experience varies considerably.

fit.note: Some customers report perfect fitting, while the overall review summary says fit is inconsistent and some buyers feel the jeans are not as slim as advertised.

comfort.note: Comfort and stretchability are repeatedly mentioned positively.

fabric_quality.note: Some buyers praise the fabric while others describe it as cheap or low quality.

value_for_money.note: Customers generally consider it a reasonable budget purchase.

color_durability.note: Multiple reviews mention fading. One buyer reported blue color transferring a tint to other clothes after washing.

appearance.note: Some buyers like the appearance, while others report that the actual color is darker or different from the advertised image.

sizing.note: Some buyers report perfect sizing, but the customer summary explicitly mentions sizing discrepancies.

durability.note: A verified buyer specifically advised not to expect high durability.

odor.note: One verified buyer reported a strong smell that remained after washing twice. This should be treated as an isolated reported issue, not a universal product characteristic.

cons: Some buyers say it is not truly slim
Color may differ from product images

best_for: Customers who prioritize comfort over durability
Customers wanting a slim-fit look at a low price
not_ideal_for: Customers highly concerned about color retention
Customers unwilling to hand-separate dark colors during washing
buying_advice.size_advice: The listed size range is 28–40. Because customer feedback reports sizing inconsistencies, recommend checking the size chart rather than relying only on the usual jeans size.
buying_advice.color_advice: The local catalog contains Dark Black, Ice Blue, Light Blue and Light Gray. Do not add additional colors unless corresponding local product assets are available.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Do not describe this as premium denim. Customer feedback is too mixed. The safer description is lightweight, stretchable and budget-friendly.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with stretch, comfort, slim-fit styling, lightweight construction and the ₹645 price. Do not lead with durability or premium quality.
buying_advice.washing_advice: The product instructions specifically say to wash dark colors separately. This is especially relevant because customer feedback includes reports of blue color transfer/fading.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Describe this as a budget slim-fit men's jean with mid-rise styling, full-length construction and stretchable cotton-Lycra fabric.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend it mainly for budget-conscious customers who value comfort and stretch. Mention that customer feedback is mixed and the overall rating is 3.6/5.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: The listed fit is Slim Fit and rise is Mid Rise. However, customer feedback on fit is mixed, so recommend checking the size chart.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_comfort: Comfort is one of the stronger positive themes. The jeans use stretchable cotton-Lycra fabric and several customers describe them as comfortable.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_quality: Give a balanced answer. Some buyers report good quality, while others describe the fabric as cheap or low quality.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_durability: Do not promise high durability. A verified buyer explicitly described it as suitable for quick casual wear and advised not to expect high durability.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_color: The local catalog contains Dark Black, Ice Blue, Light Blue and Light Gray. Customer feedback includes both positive color-retention reports and repeated fading complaints.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_washing: The official care instruction says to wash dark colors separately. This is important because customers have reported blue tint transfer and fading.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_sizing: The listed size range is 28–40. Customer reviews indicate that sizing can be inconsistent, so recommend checking the size chart.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_price: The captured listing shows ₹645 as the featured price against an MRP of ₹1,499, representing a 57% discount.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_reviews: The product has a 3.6/5 rating from 3,107 global ratings: 42% 5-star, 19% 4-star, 15% 3-star, 6% 2-star and 18% 1-star.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_daily_wear: It is suitable for casual and everyday wear, especially when comfort and low price matter more than long-term durability.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_premium_jeans: Do not recommend this as a premium option. Its main advantage is budget pricing, stretch and comfort rather than premium material quality.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: If the customer wants higher durability or premium denim, recommend a different product rather than overstating this one's quality.
